similarityReview: The 3D model accurately reconstructs the multi-tiered modern villa from the image. It captures the distinct left-forward stone block with its large window, the recessed central entrance porch supported by columns, the second-story balcony with railings, and the multi-layered hipped roofs. All roofs are modeled with downward-sloping frustum pyramids to ensure correct pitch direction. Windows are represented as distinct glass-colored boxes slightly offset to prevent Z-fighting, and the rear of the building is fully enclosed to ensure a solid 360-degree volume.
